title: Make queryable world and overlay records discoverable
description:
Improve discoverability of queryable world/campaign records for the DM.

The playtest showed that asking the model to query exact records is brittle when it does not know valid IDs. Even with a fresh campaign, overlay lore will make this more important because newly introduced subjects may not have pre-authored module IDs.

This does not need to become broad semantic search in the first pass, but the DM needs a reliable way to discover relevant records.

Acceptance criteria:
- Provide a compact index/search path for world_query or a separate world_search-style operation.
- The DM can discover queryable records by natural-ish subject terms such as:
  - "north gate"
  - "Old Renn"
  - "missing cart"
  - "rumors north of Hearthmere"
- Search/discovery results include record IDs/types suitable for follow-up world_query calls.
- Results distinguish module canon from campaign overlay lore.
- Tests cover lookup/discovery for newly recorded overlay lore.
close_reason: Implemented campaign overlay canon, truth-statused lore recording, world_query retrieval/search, audit/prompt guidance, docs, and regression coverage.
